en.heading: Welcome
en.text: LTF Dojang Hub is where your club and the Luxembourg Taekwondo Federation keep the day-to-day work: the member list, licenses, the training roll, fees, the shop, and one shared calendar. The federation checks licenses, prints the cards and keeps its own books. You use it if you work for a club or for the federation. A club admin can give a sign-in to a member aged 16 or over. Parents do not sign in. See Roles. The public page is black and red. It shows One federation. Every club. Every athlete.. Sign in opens the sign-in page. If you are already signed in, that spot shows Open dashboard. Once you are inside, Welcome back, follows the light or dark display you chose.

en.heading: Who this manual is for
en.text: The manual is organised by what you do, not by screen. Read the first two chapters, then jump to the chapter for your role. If you are… Read ------ a coach Getting started, then Coaches, Teams and competition and Calendar a club admin (president, secretary, treasurer, volunteer) chapters 2 to 11 – start with The club year at a glance working at the LTF office LTF Admin or LTF Finance the technical administrator Modules (technical administrator) Parents do not use this manual. Who can sign in is under Roles.

en.heading: How to read this manual
en.text: - A blue box, such as Sign out, is the exact wording on the screen. - Club management › navFinance › navBilling means: open that group, then that page, then that tab. - Follow numbered steps in order. A ticked line is what you should see when the step has worked. - Red numbers on a picture are explained in the list under it. Tips save you time. “Watch out” boxes protect you from mistakes that are hard to undo. “Good to know” boxes explain why the app behaves the way it does.

en.heading: Signing in
en.text: Open the address the LTF gave you. The sign-in page appears. To sign in: 1. Type your username in Username. Your username is in the welcome email, for example anne.reding. 2. Type your password in Password. 3. Click Submit. You arrive on the start page for your role, for example the club overview or the federation overview. The sign-in page uses the same black-and-red brand as the public page. Forgot password? sits with the form. See Forgotten password. There is no registration on this page. A club admin or the LTF creates your sign-in. See Club admins and Coaches. Parents are not given one.

en.heading: Your first password
en.text: A new invitation opens Set up your account. The page names your role and organisation, for example You're being set up as Club Admin for TKD Club Uelzecht (Demo).. 1. Check Username and Name. They are already filled in. 2. Type the email you will use in Email. 3. Type a password in Password and again in Confirm password. 4. Click Save and continue. The page shows Your account is ready!. Click Sign in now. A link for someone who already has a password opens Set your password instead, with Username filled in. 1. Type a new password in New password and again in Confirm password. 2. Click Set password, then Continue to login. Let your browser or password manager save the username together with the new password. The page fills in the username for exactly that reason. During first-run setup these links are not emailed. The technical administrator copies each person's link. Afterwards a club admin or the LTF can send it again. See Club admins.

en.heading: Verifying your email
en.text: If the sign-in page says your email isn't verified yet, open the verification email and click its link. No email? Click Verify your email under the sign-in button, type your email address and click Resend verification email.

en.heading: Forgotten password
en.text: On the sign-in page, click Forgot password?. Reset your password asks for the email on the account. Click Send reset link. If that address is known, a reset link is sent. The reply is the same either way, so the page does not reveal whether an account exists. No email? Ask your club admin or the LTF. On the club-admins list the row menu offers accessSendInvite when that person has not chosen a password yet, or accessSendReset when they already have one. If the message cannot be sent, the link is shown on screen as adminResetLink. The technical administrator can also use Send password reset in the ops console.

en.heading: Privacy and your data
en.text: This page is where you manage your own consent and your data. It is not in the menu, so you open it by its address. 1. Sign in. 2. In the browser's address bar, replace everything after the app's address with /en/settings/privacy, /fr/settings/privacy, /de/settings/privacy, or /lb/settings/privacy, and press Enter. The page Privacy & GDPR has three controls: - I consent to data processing. – tick or clear the box. The change is saved at once. - Export my data – shows your data on the page, under Export preview: your sign-in details and, if the sign-in is linked to a member, that member's name, grade and club, the licenses, the license and grade history, and the photo details. The page shows the data. It does not save a file. - Delete my data – deletes your sign-in. Delete my data does not ask you to confirm. Your sign-in is deleted at once, and you are signed out. If it is linked to a member, the profile photo goes, the notes on the grade history are cleared, and the private addresses on that member are removed. An administrator who deletes that sign-in removes the same private addresses. An address that belongs to someone else, such as a parent stored as a contact, stays. An invoice already sent keeps the address that was printed on it. The member record and the licenses stay with the club. This page is being reviewed. For now its text is in English only, also when you use the app in French, German, or Luxembourgish.

en.heading: The screen at a glance
en.text: Every page has the same frame: the menu on the left, a bar across the top and the work area in the middle. Editing a record opens beside the list. The list stays where it is. On a list, the actions for one row are in Row actions. Click a column heading to sort. The header also has Theme: Light, Dark or System. The public pages stay black and red. Inside, this choice sets the light or dark display, including the welcome line. On a phone, open the menu from the top left.

en.heading: Roles: who can do what
en.text: Your role decides which menu you see. One sign-in can include more than one role, for example club admin of your club and LTF admin. When it does, the header shows Desks. Open it and choose the role you want. A role marked View only can open its lists. Save, delete and import stay off, and the control says View only on this desk. With only one role, the header just shows that role. Ops console in the header opens the technical console and selects that role. Desks lists it as Superuser, next to your other roles. Choosing a club, LTF or finance role opens that role. Open federation dashboard stays only when that list cannot already open the federation overview. LTF admin, LTF finance, club admin and the technical console ask you to set up an authenticator app. For the first 14 days a notice reminds you. After that the role stays closed until you do. The language menu offers English, Français, Deutsch, and Lëtzebuergesch. English is the default. Role on screen Typical person Main work --------- Coach coach sees the training week, takes the roll, sees the calendar Club Admin president, secretary, treasurer, volunteer runs the club: members, licenses, money, training, shop LTF Admin federation office clubs, licenses, cards, transfers, national team, federation calendar LTF Finance federation treasurer federation orders, invoices, payments, books Superuser technical administrator which parts of the app each club may use, and the sign-ins Parents do not sign in. A member aged 16 or over can sign in after a club admin or the LTF creates the sign-in. Nothing is emailed until you send the link yourself. The club keeps the data and answers questions. What each club role sees in the club menu: Page Coach Club admin --------- navTraining yes ¹ yes navTeams when the competition module is on when the competition module is on Calendar yes yes navOverview, navMembers, navLicenses, navPrintJobs, navTransfers, navPromotion – ² yes navFinance, navFamilies, navShop – yes navClubAdmins, navSettings – yes ¹ Coaches see the week, take the roll and choose who taught the class. The timetable, holidays, rates and promotion rules are for club admins. ² These pages appear in a coach's menu but are not set up for coaches yet. A coach who is also a club admin uses them as a club admin. Recording payments is even stricter: it needs a current committee office. See Who may record payments.

en.heading: Modules: why some menus are missing
en.text: The LTF turns parts of the app on for each club. This manual calls those parts modules. - Club management adds navFinance, navFamilies, navTraining, navPromotion and navShop under Club management. - Event calendar adds Calendar under Event calendar. - Competition (moduleCompetition) adds navTeams under Competition. See Teams and competition. With none of these on, you still have the Club pages: members, licenses, printing and transfers. Ask the LTF if a page you need is missing. The LTF sets a yearly price for club management and the calendar. An unpaid invoice does not turn a module off. Club admins can read the estimate on the club profile. See Club fees and Profile. A bundle is two or more of those modules at one price. Under moduleOrderOnTitle, a bundle is listed only when that bundle itself was bought. A bundle that only overlaps a module you already have stays under moduleOrderChoose, and it says moduleOrderModuleOn. It does not show that module's end date, and you cannot order it again.

en.heading: Coaches
en.text: Coach A club admin makes you a coach in navSettings › clubSettingsTrainersTab. You then get a sign-in that shows Coach. The coach role is still being built. This chapter describes what works for coaches today: the training week, the roll and the calendar. When the competition module is on, coaches also open navTeams (see Teams and competition). More coach features are planned.

en.heading: Your week
en.text: Open navTraining. The tab trainingThisWeek lists every class of the week with its status and coaches.

en.heading: Taking the roll
en.text: Do this during or right after the class. It takes less than a minute. 1. In navTraining › trainingThisWeek, click trainingOpenRoll next to the class. 2. The usual students are already on the roll. Click a name to take it off if that student was absent. 3. Under trainingAddStudents, tick anyone else who came. Search by name if the list is long. 4. Check trainingSessionCoaches. 5. Click trainingSaveRoll. The class now shows as trainingStatusheld and its hours count towards each student's next belt (see Promotion) and towards coach pay. Take the roll on a phone at the side of the mat. The page is made for small screens.

en.heading: Calendar for coaches
en.text: Coaches see public club events and also calendarVisibilityinternal ones, so the club can share coach meetings with its coaches and admins only. See Calendar.

en.heading: Club admin: members and licenses
en.text: Club admin

en.heading: Club overview
en.text: navOverview is your start page. It opens with Welcome back, and your first name. Needs your attention lists what needs you, or Nothing needs your attention right now. when nothing does. The page also counts members, licenses and open invoices. actionQueueTitle lists what is waiting, and each line opens the right page.

en.heading: The members list
en.text: navMembers lists everyone in your club. The sexLabel column is a small ♂ or ♀. Click a column heading to sort. membersMenuLabel and the row menu open as small panels. Search stays on the page. The other filters open from Status, User and Person. User is accountFilterNone, accountFilterPending, accountFilterActive or accountFilterDisabled. On the LTF list, Person is All, Club members or LTF staff. On the club list, Person is the team filter when competition is on, including teamsFilterNone. Reset filters puts the filters back to the usual start. A tick stays when you search, filter or change page, until you clearSelection or finish the action. selectedMembersCountLabel includes rows that are not on this page. The same ticks stay on the club and LTF member lists, the club and LTF license lists, the LTF clubs list, the technical console's users, parked members, and club billing. You can show 50, 150, 300 or all rows. License tables have an expiresLabel column. A date within 30 days is a warning. A date already past is muted. Click a name to open the member. The Actions menu works on all ticked members at once: Prefer making a member inactive to deleting. Deleting also deletes the member's licenses; an inactive member keeps their history.

en.heading: Adding a member
en.text: 1. In navMembers, open membersMenuLabel and click createMember. The form opens beside the list. The list stays where it is. 2. Fill in firstNameLabel, lastNameLabel, sexLabel and dobLabel. 3. Choose the ltfLicensePrefixLabel. The LTF license number itself is created automatically when you save. Fill in WT license ID only if the athlete already has a World Taekwondo license. 4. Set the belt grade after saving, on the memberGradesTab tab. 5. Click createMember.

en.heading: Importing members from a spreadsheet
en.text: Use this once, when your club starts with the app, or to add a whole group. 1. Save your list as a CSV file (one row per person, one column per field). 2. In navMembers, open membersMenuLabel and click Import members. 3. Source and options: under Existing members, leave Create new only (skip existing) or choose Create new and update existing when the file should refresh people already in the club. Existing members are matched by LTF license ID, then WT license ID, then last name, first name, and date of birth in this club. Empty cells never clear stored values. Choose the Date format used in your file and click Choose CSV file. Click Continue to mapping. 4. Field mapping: for each field of the app, pick the matching column of your file. Auto-map matching fields does most of the work. All fields marked Required must be mapped. 5. Preview and resolve: click Preview. Each row is Ready, Duplicate, Invalid or Skipped. The same Existing members choice is on this step. Fix your file or change the action for a row. 6. Confirm import: click Run import. 7. Import result shows what was created, updated and skipped. The success line reads Import succeeded. Created 12, updated 3, skipped 1.. If your file has a membership end date column, use Use membership end dates by year to import current members as active and skip people who left years ago. This is the club's own import, for a club that already uses the app. The federation's first import of every club is a different page, First-run setup, and only the technical administrator sees it. Empty cells never wipe a value that is already stored.

en.heading: The member record
en.text: A member's page has six tabs. If the athlete is on the national team, the overview shows nationalTeamBadge with the squad and the season. You cannot change it here. The club does not open the federation's staff file, and coach names are not listed on this page. The squad itself is kept by the LTF. See National team. When the competition module is on, the overview also shows teamsCardTitle and gearTitle. Height and weight are recorded on the team sheet, not as a tab here. See Height and weight and Equipment sizes.

en.heading: The club record
en.text: memberClubRecordTab holds the details the club needs for daily life. Everything is optional; fill in what you use. It also contains Social security number, Joined this club, two nationalities, Medical conditions / special needs, Email addresses, Phone numbers, Addresses, Publication consent and the Médico sportif dates. Click Save club record when you are done. For an address in Luxembourg, type a street or a postcode and pick a suggestion. The list is the official Luxembourg address register. Choosing one fills Street, House number, Postal code and City / locality as separate fields. The street box keeps only the street name. A house number may include a letter, for example 12A. Tick Send invoices here on the address that should receive invoices. Only one address receives invoices. Choosing this one clears the others. For a child, add the parent under Contact persons and tick Also use this parent for the other children in the family to reuse the same parent for brothers and sisters.

en.heading: A member's photo
en.text: The photo is printed on the license card, so a good photo saves a reprint. 1. Open the member and click photoChangeButton. 2. Drop a picture into the box, click photoSelectFileButton, or click photoCameraButton and then photoCameraCaptureButton. 3. Use photoZoomLabel and drag the picture until the face fills the 8:10 frame. The photoPreviewTitle shows the result. 4. If you like, click photoRemoveBackgroundButton. The colour under photoBackgroundColorLabel is set by the federation and is applied for you. A bar shows the progress. You can still save the photo if removal fails. 5. Wait until the face check says the photo can be saved. It looks for one person, facing the camera. If the check cannot run, you can still save, and the club reviews the photo. 6. Tick photoConsentLabel. 7. Click photoSaveButton. A plain wall, good light and a straight look into the camera give the best result. JPEG, PNG and HEIC photos up to 10 MB are accepted.

en.heading: Ordering licenses
en.text: Every athlete needs a yearly LTF license. You order licenses for several members at once; the LTF then invoices your club. 1. In navMembers, tick the members who need a license. 2. Open Actions and click actionOrderLicense. 3. Choose the yearLabel. Depending on federation policy you can order for this year or pre-order for next year. 4. Under orderLicenseAvailableTypesTitle, click a license type marked orderLicenseStatusAvailable. 5. Check orderLicenseReviewTitle. Members who already have this license are listed under orderLicenseAlreadyLicensedTitle; click orderLicenseResolveDuplicatesAction or orderLicenseResolveBlockedAction if needed. 6. Click orderLicenseButton. The page shows orderLicenseSuccessTitle. The licenses are statusPending until the LTF has received your payment and activated them. A license type you cannot choose shows why, for example orderLicenseUnavailableReasonWindow or orderLicenseUnavailableReasonNoPrice. Ordering windows and prices are set by the LTF. The order and its invoice appear under navFinance › navOrders and navInvoices. On those lists, and on navPayments, search stays on the page. Status opens as a small panel. On the club lists, financeLedgerLabel opens the same way. Reset filters puts them back to all. Those lists do not tick rows. Pay the federation invoice as explained in Paying the LTF.

en.heading: The licenses list
en.text: navLicenses shows every license of the club, with filterActiveTitle, filterPendingTitle or filterExpiredTitle. Search by member, year or status. Click a column heading to sort. The expiresLabel column uses the same dates as the rest of the app. A date within 30 days is a warning. A date already past is muted. Ticks on this list stay when you search, filter or change page. On the federation's own license list, edit and delete sit in the row menu, and the form opens beside the list. See Members, licenses and transfers. A club admin creates a sign-in for the club's own members with createUserAccounts. An LTF admin can do it for every member, including someone with no club. accountConfirm says what will be created and who is skipped. accountNoEmailSent There is no sign-in under 16. Save a missing date of birth first. Inactive members are skipped. When the sign-ins exist, a file of first-sign-in links is saved. accountFileWarning Linking a sign-in that already exists does not make that file. The members list and the member card show accountBadgeNone, accountBadgePending, accountBadgeActive or accountBadgeDisabled.

en.heading: Printing license cards
en.text: navPrinting lists the club's card print jobs. The same section also opens navPrinterProfiles, where the shift for a printer is stored. 1. Open navPrinting. 2. Open the row menu. When a job shows printJobStatusSucceeded, click printJobPreviewPdfAction to open the PDF, or printJobDownloadPdfAction to save license-cards.pdf. Print the file at 100 % (no “fit to page”). 3. The same menu holds printJobExecuteAction, printJobRetryAction and printJobCancelAction. deleteAction is last. Confirm to remove a draft, a job that succeeded, a job that failed, or a job you cancelled. If the job is still waiting or still printing, cancel it before you delete it. If the card sits a few millimetres off the page, ask the LTF for a printer profile with the right shift. Do not change the card design to compensate.

en.heading: Transfers between clubs
en.text: A member who moves to another club is sent by the old club and accepted by the new one. The license and history move with the member. To send a member to another club: 1. Open navTransfers. 2. Click the member in the left column, then click the destination club on the right. Type in the search boxes to find them faster. 3. Enter a transferFeeAmountLabel if your club charges one, or leave it at 0 for a free transfer, and add a note. 4. Click transferSendRequest. To answer a request from another club: 1. Open navTransfers. Incoming requests are listed under transferInboxTitle › transferIncomingLabel. 2. Click the request. Read the messages; write one with transferSendMessage if you have a question. 3. Click transferAcceptAction or transferRejectAction. The sending club can cancel its own request until the other club has answered. Only clubs that have a club admin can receive transfers.

en.heading: Club admin: money
en.text: Club adminClub management module Under navFinance you find the club's books. The tabs across the top are: navOrders, navInvoices, navPayments, navBilling, navMembershipFees, navIncome, navExpenses, navBank, navReports and navSubsidies. The club's books contain two kinds of invoices: LTF invoices (licenses your club buys from the federation) and club invoices (membership fees and shop sales you bill to your members). The financeLedgerLabel filter on navInvoices switches between them.

en.heading: Who may record payments
en.text: Payments and other changes to the club's books need a current committee office: paymentsRecordDenied Make sure the committee is up to date in navSettings › clubSettingsCommitteeTab (see Committee).

en.heading: Families and rebates
en.text: A family groups members who live together so they get one invoice and family rebates. 1. Open navFamilies. Type a familyName and click createFamily. 2. Open the family and add the members in rebate order: rank 1 pays full price, rank 2 gets the second-member rebate, and so on. 3. Under receivesTheBill, choose who receives the bill, or click addParentOrGuardian for a parent who is not a member. 4. Choose the deliveryLabel. billToDeliveryAuto is a safe default. Use familyInvoicePreview to check the amounts before you bill.

en.heading: Membership fees
en.text: navMembershipFees is the price list. Set it up once; it carries over to the next year. 1. Under membershipFee, type a feeName (for example “Adults”) and an feeAmount, then click saveFee. Add one fee per kind of dues, such as children, adults, family. 2. When a price changes, do not create a new fee: open the fee, enter the new amount and priceFrom date and click saveNewPrice. 3. Under licenseFeeTitle, set the amount you charge members for their LTF license, or leave 0.00. 4. Under billingsTitle, click addBilling only if you bill the membership fee more than once a year (for example a spring bill). Then choose under licenseFeeBilling which bill carries the license fee – see When the license fee is charged. 5. Under rebateRules, click addRebate for rank 2, 3… Choose rebateKindPercent or rebateKindAmount. Tick rebateAppliesToLater so that every further child gets the same rebate. The license fee is added once per member and season, on the bill chosen under licenseFeeBilling. Family rebates never reduce it.

en.heading: Billing the year
en.text: Once fees and families are ready, billing the whole club takes a few clicks. 1. Open navFinance › navBilling and choose the billingYear. 2. Look for households marked billingBlocked. The reason is shown in the row: usually chooseBillRecipient (for a child) or a missing membership fee. Fix them in navFamilies or navMembershipFees. 3. Click selectReady. 4. Click reviewIssueAction, check the totals in the confirmation and click issueInvoicesAction. 5. Email invoices are sent at once. For the rest, click printPackAction and print the PDF. The total in the email is the same total as on the PDF. A paid invoice says the amount paid. An invoice that is not paid says the amount due. A reminder states the amount still due. The households now show billingInvoiced. They turn billingPaid when you record the payment. A member with a fee of 0.00 gets a bill of 0,00 marked paid, as proof of membership. This does not replace an LTF license.

en.heading: When the license fee is charged
en.text: The Taekwondo season runs from September to September, like the Luxembourg school year. The license fee is normally charged with the first bill of the season. In the app, however, billings are counted per calendar year (billingYear), so the first bill of the season is not always billingInstallmentNumber. - One bill a year (usually in autumn): it opens the season and carries the license fee. There is nothing to set. - Two bills a year: the spring bill covers the second half of the running season, and the autumn bill opens the new season. The autumn bill is then the second bill of the calendar or financial year, and it is the one that should carry the license fee. Example: a club bills in February and in October 2026. Bill In the app Season License fee? ------------ February 2026 billingInstallmentNumber, label “Spring” second half of 2025/26 no – already charged in October 2025 October 2026 billingInstallmentNumber, label “Autumn” start of 2026/27 yes To set this up: 1. Open navFinance › navMembershipFees and pick the billingYear under billingsTitle. 2. Click addBilling and enter a billingLabel for the new bill, for example “Autumn”. 3. Under licenseFeeBilling, choose billingInstallmentNumber. The app describes this rule in two places. navBilling says the license fee is added “on each member's first bill”; navMembershipFees says “on the billing chosen for that year”. Both mean the same bill: the one chosen under licenseFeeBilling, which is the first bill of the season. A member who joins after that billing has started pays the license fee on the next bill. Invoices already issued stay as they are.

en.heading: Recording a payment
en.text: 1. Open navFinance › navInvoices and click recordPaymentButton next to the invoice. 2. Check the paymentDateLabel. It defaults to today. 3. paymentReferenceLabel is pre-filled with the invoice number, so it matches the bank transfer. 4. Choose the paymentMethodLabel and click recordPaymentButton. Ask parents to put the invoice number in the transfer communication. It makes bank matching (below) almost automatic.

en.heading: Paying the LTF
en.text: LTF invoices for your license orders are in navInvoices with the financeLedgerLabel filter set to LTF. Pay by bank transfer and put the invoice number in the communication. LTF Finance records the payment and activates the licenses. Or pay by card. On an issued LTF invoice that still has an amount open, open the row menu or the invoice and click Pay now. You leave this app for the card company's page. That page shows one line for this LTF invoice, with the invoice number and the amount still open, and the fields for the card. Confirm the payment there. You come back to this app, the licenses are activated, and the page reads Payment successful. If you use the card company's back link and do not pay, you return here and the page reads Payment cancelled. Nothing is charged and the licenses stay as they were. A club invoice sent to a member is not paid on this page. A member's sign-in does not open this card payment. On both pages, the button under the title is the way back. It names the role you left: - Back to club dashboard – the usual label when a club admin started from the club's invoices - Back to LTF dashboard - Back to finance dashboard - Back to your account - Back to ops Club invoices that you send to your own members are not paid with this button. Record those yourself. See Recording a payment. If the card page does not open, the screen says Unable to start payment.. The invoice is unchanged. Pay it by bank transfer.

en.heading: Other income and expenses
en.text: - navIncome: click recordIncomeAction for subsidies, donations, sponsoring and other income. Attach a receiptLabel if you have one. - navExpenses: the page for the club's own expenses. Its subtitle reads Record this club's expenses for the annual books and reports. Click recordExpenseAction. The form confirms that the expense goes to your club's accounts, not the federation's: Book an expense against this club's accounts. Fill in expenseDateLabel, expenseCategoryLabel, expenseDescriptionLabel, expensePayeeLabel and expenseAmountLabel. Tick expenseAlreadyPaidLabel if the money has left the account and choose the paymentMethodLabel. You can attach a receiptLabel (PDF or image). Wrong entry? Open it and use voidIncomeAction or voidExpenseAction. Voided entries stay visible for the auditors.

en.heading: Bank reconciliation
en.text: navBank compares your bank statement with the books. No bank connection is used: you upload a file. 1. Download a CSV or CAMT.053 statement from your online banking. 2. In navBank, click under bankFileLabel to choose the file, then click importStatementAction. 3. Open the statement. Match each line to a payment, income or expense, or mark bank-only items such as fees as ignored.

en.heading: Reports for the general assembly
en.text: navReports prepares the income statement, the cash movement and a budget comparison for a reportYearLabel. Enter the openingCashTitle once per year and click saveOpeningCashAction. exportExcelAction downloads everything as a spreadsheet for the auditors.

en.heading: Subsidies
en.text: navSubsidies prepares the yearly MyGuichet file for the ministry and fills extraordinary grant forms. The app does not send anything: you still file the application yourself. 1. Choose the subsidiesYear. The default filing deadline is 30 September. 2. Work through subsidiesChecklist until every point is green. 3. Upload the subsidiesRibFile. 4. Under subsidiesCoaches, set each coach's subsidiesEqf and upload the diploma. Coaches are appointed in navSettings › clubSettingsTrainersTab. 5. Download the subsidiesTrainingList and the subsidiesTrainersList. The president or a delegated committee member certifies them. 6. Under subsidiesYouth, type each child's national number and export the subsidiesExportYouth. 7. Copy the subsidiesEffectifs table into MyGuichet. 8. After filing, record subsidiesSubmittedOn, and later subsidiesPaidOn and subsidiesPaidAmount. The next time a president, vice president, treasurer or secretary opens the page, the amount is added to club income. The scores are calculated as follows: Score Rule used by the app ------ subsidiesVolunteerPoints fewer than 50 licensed members: 150 · 50 to 200: 300 · more than 200: 500 subsidiesCoachPoints per coach, by qualification: EQF 1 and 2 = 20 · EQF 2 bis and 3 = 40 · EQF 4 = 60 · EQF 5 and 6 = 100 subsidiesQualite €150 per licensed athlete under 16 For trips to a championship or an international cup, use subsidiesExtraordinary: choose the subsidiesKind, add athletes and officials, enter travel, stay and entry costs, click subsidiesCreateCase and then subsidiesDownloadForm. An official must be an adult with a license for that year. subsidiesOfficialsAdults The list offers the members who hold a license for the year, and only the adults among them can be officials. Saving a person who has no license for the year is refused.

en.heading: Club admin: training and promotion
en.text: Club adminCoachClub management module navTraining has six tabs: trainingThisWeek, trainingMonth, trainingYear, trainingTimetable, trainingHolidays and trainingCoachHours.

en.heading: Setting up the timetable
en.text: Do this once at the start of the season. Each class then repeats every week until the end date. 1. Open trainingTimetable. 2. Under trainingAddClass, enter trainingClassName, trainingAudience, trainingWeekday, trainingStarts and trainingEnds, and the season subsidiesFrom / subsidiesTo. Choose the training venue from club settings. The place is optional. A class saved earlier with only a place name keeps that name. 3. Keep trainingSkipPublic and trainingSkipSchool ticked if the club pauses then. 4. Tick trainingCountsUnder16 for classes that belong on the Qualité+ training list. 5. Choose the trainingUsualCoaches and the trainingRegulars. The regulars are pre-selected on every roll. 6. Click trainingAddClass.

en.heading: Holidays
en.text: trainingHolidays lists Luxembourg's trainingPublicHolidays for the year. Add your trainingSchoolHolidays with trainingAddHoliday. Classes that skip holidays are left out automatically on those days.

en.heading: Month and year views
en.text: trainingMonth shows the classes as a calendar; trainingYear shows one mark per class over the whole season. Open a day to take the roll.

en.heading: Coach pay
en.text: trainingCoachHours adds up what each coach is owed. 1. Set trainingPayFrequency and the paydays, then click trainingSavePaydays. 2. Under trainingPayRateTitle, choose for each coach trainingBasisHourly or trainingBasisUnit, enter the trainingRateColumn and click trainingSaveRate. 3. Under trainingOutingsTitle, add a row for a tournament, fuel or a hotel the club pays. Only held classes (roll saved) are paid. Every coach listed on a class gets that class in full.

en.heading: Promotion rules and belt tests
en.text: navPromotion says how many training hours a student needs before the next grade. Hours are counted from the student's last grade. To set a rule: 1. Choose the trainingNextGrade. 2. Enter the trainingRequiredHours. 3. Under trainingHoursCount, choose trainingHoursAll or one kind of class. 4. Click trainingSaveRule. To run a belt test: 1. Under trainingBeltTests, enter the name and trainingDate and click trainingAddBeltTest. 2. Click trainingOpenTest. Candidates show their trainingHoursSoFar and whether they are trainingReady or trainingShort. 3. On the day, click trainingPass or trainingFail for each candidate. A pass records the new grade on the member's memberGradesTab tab.

en.heading: Club admin: teams and competition
en.text: Club adminCoachCompetition module navTeams appears under Competition when the LTF has switched on moduleCompetition. A member can be on more than one team. Coaches can open these pages. The clothing list and the electronic-gear switches are for club admins.

en.heading: Teams
en.text: 1. Open navTeams and click teamsAdd. The form opens beside the list. 2. Enter teamsName. Choose teamsDisciplineKyorugi or teamsDisciplinePoomsae. Click teamsSave. 3. Open the team. teamsManageAction adds and removes people. Each person is teamRoleAthlete or teamRoleCoach. Coaches are listed first. 4. On the sheet, open teamCompetition. Enter teamCompetitionDate and teamCompetitionName, then click teamCompetitionAdd. Age classes use that date's year. teamCompetitionRemove clears the date, the name and the category set. The squad, the weights and the pairs stay. 5. teamWeighIn records a weight for the whole squad on one date. A blank weight is skipped. teamExportCsv and teamExportPdf download the sheet. 6. For poomsae, teamGroupsTitle builds pairs and teams of three. 7. teamDuplicateAction copies the current squad onto a new team. Height and weight stay on each person. 8. teamHistory opens teamHistoryTitle: who was on the squad on the date you pick, and who was added or removed. On navMembers, teamsFilterNone lists members who are not on a team.

en.heading: Height and weight
en.text: On the team sheet, expand a person and open heightWeightTitle. heightWeightHint Click heightWeightAdd and record a dated weight, a height, or both. Only this club can see the measurements. They are not printed on the license card.

en.heading: Equipment sizes
en.text: Sizes are kept in three groups: gearProtectors, gearEgear and gearClothingOther. On the member's overview, gearTitle leads to gearEdit. The same summary is on the team sheet. The club decides which clothes it orders. Open navSettings › clubSettingsEquipmentTab. Under clothingSizesTitle, click clothingAdd and enter the sizes you actually buy. clothingSizesHint Under egearBrandsTitle, switch gearDaedo or gearKpnp off if the club does not use that brand. egearBrandsHint Sizes already stored on members stay, including when the brand is switched off.

en.heading: Club admin: the club shop
en.text: Club adminClub management module navShop sells doboks, belts and protectors at the club desk. It has three tabs: shopTabSell, shopTabItems and shopTabSales.

en.heading: Adding an item
en.text: 1. Open shopTabItems and click shopAddItem. 2. Tap shopPhoto to take a photo with your phone. 3. Enter shopItemName, shopCategory, shopPurchasePrice and shopSalePrice. 4. Tick shopTrackStock if you want the app to stop selling when the shelf is empty. 5. Click saveItem. 6. Under shopSizes, add each size with its own prices and the number shopOnShelfNow. shopWarnBelow flags low stock. When a box of goods arrives, open the item and use shopGoodsArrived. Then shopPrintStickersNext prints QR stickers on Avery Zweckform L7121-25 sheets.

en.heading: Selling at the desk
en.text: 1. Open shopTabSell. Scan the sticker or tap the item and its size. 2. Under shopSoldTo, search the member, or choose shopWalkIn. 3. Choose shopPayCash, shopPayCard, shopPayOther or shopPayLater. 4. Click shopCompleteSale. Unpaid sales wait in shopTabSales until you click shopMarkPaidCash or shopMarkPaidCard.

en.heading: Counting stock
en.text: Before a stock count, click shopPrintCountSheet on shopTabItems and then shopTakeCountSheet. Tick the printed sheet against the cupboard. shopPrintCatalogue prints a price list for the notice board.

en.heading: Calendar
en.text: All rolesEvent calendar module The calendar is shared by the LTF and all clubs. Each event decides who can see it.

en.heading: Creating an event
en.text: 1. Click New event. 2. Enter Title, Starts and Ends (or tick All day), Venue and Address. 3. Choose the Kind: General, Kyorugi or Poomsae. 4. Under Who can see this, choose who sees it (table below). 5. Click Save event. Choice Club event: who sees it LTF event: who sees it --------- Public members, admins and coaches of this club, plus LTF Admin everyone signed in Internal this club's admins and coaches LTF Admin, LTF Finance, club admins and coaches Private this club's admins only LTF Admins only All clubs and the LTF LTF and every club's admins and coaches, plus this club's members LTF and every club's admins and coaches Club presidents – LTF Admins and the current president of each club ticked under Concerned clubs The descriptions on screen also mention members. A member sees an event only with a sign-in, and only when the choice includes members. See Roles. Planning a club tournament? Use All clubs and the LTF so other clubs see the date early and avoid clashes.

en.heading: Reminders
en.text: Open an event, choose a date in Remind me on and click Save reminder. On that day a reminder pops up when you are in the app. Click Snooze for a day or Got it. Remove reminder removes it.

en.heading: Club admin: club profile, committee and admins
en.text: Club admin navSettings has four tabs. When the competition module is on, clubSettingsEquipmentTab is a further tab. See Equipment sizes.

en.heading: Profile
en.text: Keep the clubEmailLabel, clubWebsiteLabel, ibanLabel and clubLanguageLabel correct: they are printed on the invoices you send to members, and the LTF writes to you in that language. clubLanguageLabel can be English, Français, Deutsch, or Lëtzebuergesch. clubLanguageHint Emails and PDFs use the language chosen for that person, otherwise this language, otherwise English. French says licence. German says Lizenz. In German the income statement is Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung. The official subsidy lists stay in French. Set federationLabel to federationWt or federationItf. Enter the rcsNumberLabel when the club has one, for example B123456. headOfficeLabel is the registered office, not a training hall. It uses the same Luxembourg address lookup as a member address: street, number, postcode and locality stay separate. See The club record. Training venues lists the halls where the club trains. Click Add venue, enter a name and an address, and save. A venue is not the head office. modulePricesTitle shows what the federation charges this club for each module. The amount is an estimate. You can read it even when a module is off. You cannot change the price here. A minimum that is not higher than a flat price is not shown. The price you pay is the same. Under Logos, upload the logos used on invoices, cards and screens. After you choose a file, the page shows a preview. While it loads, it says Loading logo preview. Click saveClub.

en.heading: Coaches
en.text: 1. Open clubSettingsTrainersTab. 2. Click a member on the left, then click the trainersDropColumn box on the right. 3. If the member has no email yet, enter one in trainerEmailPlaceholder and click trainerAdd. The coach receives a welcome email to set a password. 4. Tick trainerQualite for coaches who belong in the Qualité+ file. Coaches must be active adult members of your own club. trainerRemove removes the coach role; the person stays a member.

en.heading: Committee
en.text: The committee decides who may record payments, and its president receives meetings for club presidents. 1. Open clubSettingsCommitteeTab. If needed, click createCommittee. 2. Under committeeOffices, choose an office such as President, enter committeeStart and click addMandate. 3. Click the office, then click the member who holds it. To correct an office that already has a holder, open the row menu and click committeeEditTerm. The panel is committeeEditTitle. The person field already shows the current holder, family name then given name, even when that person is not on the first page of members. Saving without a change keeps that person. A new office still starts empty, on committeeNeedMember. To hand an office to the next person, open committeeHistoryTitle. In the row menu click committeeReplaceTerm. The panel is committeeReplaceTitle. Choose the new person and the date of the election. committeeReplaceHint Click committeeSaveTerm. To close an office without naming a successor, use committeeEndTerm. committeeEndHint The federation committee page works the same way. LTF Admin opens it from Committee. Handing over a federation office can search every adult, including someone with no club. People under 18 and inactive members are left out. Linking a sign-in to a member who already holds a federation office opens the federation roles that office includes. In the usual setup, President gets LTF Admin in full and LTF Finance as view only, and Treasurer the other way round. Changing or clearing that sign-in moves or closes those roles. Someone still waiting to be placed in a club gets no federation role. An inactive member still gets the roles the setup allows. A contact needs a sign-in before a federation role is linked. A club office does not open a federation role. When the treasurer changes, update the committee before the next payment run. Without a current office nobody in the club can record payments.

en.heading: Publication consent
en.text: clubSettingsPublicationTab shows a grid of members and channels (website, print media, Facebook, Instagram…). Each tick is saved immediately. Before posting photos, tick the channels and download publicationPdfList to get the list of members who must not be shown.

en.heading: Club admins
en.text: navClubAdmins decides who runs the club in the app. 1. Open navClubAdmins. Click your club on the right to list its members. 2. Click a member, then click the club again. 3. If the member has no sign-in yet, enter an email under adminEmailTitle. A welcome email is sent. The invited person sets an email and a password on Your first password. Under adminsCurrentTitle you can remove someone who should no longer administer the club. adminsLicensedOnly limits the list to members with a valid license. The row menu can send the link again: accessSendInvite if that person has not chosen a password yet, or accessSendReset if they have. You can also copy the link. The same actions are on the LTF's club-admins page. See Clubs and club admins.

en.heading: The club year at a glance
en.text: A checklist for the busy volunteer. Each line links to the section that explains it. When Task Section --------- Summer Update committee, coaches, club profile Committee Before the season Timetable, holidays, promotion rules Timetable Before a competition Team sheet, weigh-in, equipment sizes Teams September Fees and family rebates Membership fees September Order licenses for all athletes Ordering licenses September Pay the LTF invoice Paying the LTF Once paid Print license cards Printing cards By 30 September Subsidy file Subsidies October Bill membership fees Billing Every class Take the roll Taking the roll Monthly Record payments, import the bank statement Bank Before a grading Belt test Promotion Year end Reports for the general assembly Reports

en.heading: LTF Admin
en.text: LTF Admin The federation menu, under LTF management, contains Overview, Clubs, Club admins, Transfers, Members, Parked members, National team, Licenses, License cards, Printing, License types and Settings, plus Committee and Calendar.

en.heading: Federation overview
en.text: The overview counts clubs, members and licenses. It also lists what needs you: clubs without an admin, transfers that still have a fee, and members waiting for a license.

en.heading: Clubs and club admins
en.text: Clubs lists all clubs. Open a club to edit its details, upload its logos (for invoices, printing and screens) and see its members. On the club's page, set Federation to WT or ITF, and the RCS number when you have one (for example B123456). Head office (siège social) uses the Luxembourg address lookup. Training venues lists training halls and is not the head office. The same fields are on the club's own Profile. After you upload a logo, the page shows a preview. While it loads, it says Loading logo preview. Club admins works like the club page described in Club admins, but for every club. The row menu sends a link again: accessSendInvite or accessCopyInvite when the person has not chosen a password yet, and accessSendReset or accessCopyReset when they have. Copying does not need an email address. Sending does. Each invitation link works once. See Your first password.

en.heading: Members, licenses and transfers
en.text: - Members and Licenses show all clubs at once. Use the club panel at the top to narrow the list. Click a column heading to sort. On the license list, editAction and deleteAction are in Row actions, and edit opens beside the list. - Filter members with LTF staff to see federation staff. A person with no club is shown as No club. Add LTF staff opens beside the list. Leave the club on No club to license them as LTF staff, with no club order and no club invoice. Issue license issues the license for the year you choose. The current year is active at once. A past staff license expires like a club license and then shows as expired. - Parked members lists people saved during an import until you assign a club and a sex, or delete the row. People saved from an import until you assign a club and a gender, or delete them. They are not in a club list, a license, a card, a team or a count. See First-run setup. - Transfers lists recent club changes, transfers with a fee and possible club tourists – members who changed club unusually often.

en.heading: License cards
en.text: License cards holds the card templates. Open a template in the designer to place the photo, name, grade, license number and QR code. The row menu also sets the default, saves a copy, exports or deletes the template. Publish a version and set it as the default: club admins print with it. Printing groups Card print jobs and Printer profiles the same way as in the club. Print jobs lists every club's jobs. Preview, save and delete are in the row menu. Printer profiles store how far a known printer shifts the card.

en.heading: National team
en.text: National team is the federation's page for the squads. LTF Admin can change it. LTF Finance can open the same page and only read it. Clubs do not see this page. On a club member they only see nationalTeamBadge, with the squad and the season, and not this staff file. The page has three parts: Selections, Staff and Levels and season. Filters use Season, Squad and Club. Forms open beside the list. Selections. Add squad adds a squad. A new squad is for Kyorugi. Poomsae squads are not part of this version. Add selection adds an athlete from a club for the season. Set Age class. The classes include Pupils and Minimes, which are regional and not World Taekwondo divisions, plus Cadet, Junior and Senior. Weight may be left empty. Status is recorded as LTF level, COSL and Sportlycée / SSEA (Sportlycée or SSEA). Staff. Open Staff and click Add staff. Roles include National coach, Physiotherapist and Photographer. The name and the role are what a club is allowed to know. The private staff file stays on this page. Levels and season. Levels and season holds the cadre levels and the season dates. Save season dates stores the start and end. One squad at a time keeps an athlete on one squad at a time.

en.heading: Federation settings
en.text: Settings holds the federation address and IBAN, the clubTouristThresholdLabel and the import option importPrefixRewriteLabel. It also holds the federation's RCS number. The address uses the Luxembourg lookup. Registered office of the federation. Lookup fills streets in Luxembourg. Other addresses stay manual.

en.heading: LTF Finance
en.text: LTF Finance The finance menu contains Overview, Orders, Invoices, Payments, Income, Expenses, Bank, Reports, Audit log and Settings.

en.heading: License prices and ordering windows
en.text: In Settings, the tab settingsTabLicenseTypes defines each type and its currentYearWindowLabel and nextYearWindowLabel. settingsTabLicensePrices stores prices with history: a new price applies from its priceEffectiveFromLabel date.

en.heading: Club fees
en.text: settingsTabClubFees lists what the LTF charges clubs (affiliation, insurance…), clubFeeCadenceAnnual, clubFeeCadencePerMember, clubFeeCadencePerEvent or clubFeeCadenceOneOff. On the settingsTabBilling tab, choose the clubFeeBillingYearLabel, the fees and the clubs, and click clubFeeBillingSubmitYear. A club already invoiced for that year is skipped, so you can run it again safely. clubFeeBillingRecurringLabel repeats the billing monthly or yearly. settingsTabModuleFees is the yearly price for moduleClubManagement and the event calendar. moduleFeesTitle Click moduleFeeAdd, choose the module, then moduleFeePricingFlat or moduleFeePricingPerMember, and type the amount. moduleFeeMinimumLabel is optional. The club pays at least that amount when the calculated price is lower. When that minimum is not higher than a flat price, modulePricesTitle on the club profile does not show it. The club still pays the same amount, and this page still shows the field. A new price starts on the date you choose. Invoices already sent stay as they are. moduleFeeBillingHint Club admins can read the estimate on their profile. They cannot change it. An unpaid invoice does not turn the module off.

en.heading: Invoices, payments and credit notes
en.text: 1. Open Invoices and click an invoice. 2. When the club's transfer has arrived, click recordPaymentButton. Paid licenses become active. 3. To reduce what a club owes, enter a creditNoteAmountLabel and creditNoteReasonLabel and click addCreditNoteAction. 4. To chase an unpaid invoice, click sendReminderAction. lastRemindedAtLabel shows when you last did. The total in the email is the same total as on the PDF. A paid invoice says the amount paid. An invoice that is not paid says the amount due. That includes a license invoice marked paid in the same step as the email. A reminder states the amount still due, not the original total. The wording follows the club's language, or the language chosen for that person, otherwise English. See Profile. On Orders, Invoices, and Payments, search stays on the page and Status opens as a small panel. Reset filters returns it to all. Those lists do not tick rows. See Ordering licenses.

en.heading: Federation books
en.text: Income, Expenses, Bank and Reports work like the club pages in Club admin: money, for the federation's own accounts. Audit log records who changed what.

en.heading: Modules (technical administrator)
en.text: Superuser The technical administrator opens the Ops console. Under Modules, enter the code the LTF sent you and confirm it. Then choose the parts of the app each club may use. The list also names parts that have no pages yet, such as federation inventory and tournaments. You cannot turn those on. Turning a part on is separate from its price. Prices for club management and the calendar are module fees. An unpaid invoice does not turn the part off.

en.heading: First-run setup
en.text: First-run setup is for the technical administrator, once, before the federation works in the app. It is not the club import in Importing members. It is hidden on the demonstration installation, and it locks when you finish. Open the technical console. If setup is still open, the overview sends you to this page, and a bar at the top offers Finish setup. Import clubs, then members and LTF staff, then club admins. Nothing is emailed. You bring in three files, in order. Nothing on this page sends an email, and email addresses in the files are ignored. Email addresses are not imported 1. Clubs. Upload the club export. A row named LTF is not created as a club. Federation (WT or ITF) is only a guess from the name: change it if it is wrong. An RCS number is optional; if you type one, use the form B123456. Click Confirm clubs. 2. Members and LTF staff. Upload the member export. Match the columns, check the preview, then confirm. This is not the club import. Match the Member ID column to both the WT license id and the LTF license id. Auto-map matching fields does that. Leave Email unmatched. If importPrefixRewriteLabel is on, LUX- becomes LTF- on the LTF id only. Active or inactive follows the membership end year, not a separate column. This year or a later year, and a blank date, are Active. An earlier year is Inactive, and the person is still imported. If the end date cannot be read, choose Active or Inactive, or park the row. Do not guess. 3. Park a row when the club cell is empty, the club is not one you imported, or the end date cannot be read. Click Park, or Park all unresolved for every row that can be parked. The status is Parked. For an empty club cell, No club yet is a real choice and parks that person for later. LTF staff is the choice when the person belongs to the federation rather than a club. You may confirm while parked rows remain. Confirm is blocked until every red row is resolved, parked, or skipped. Click Confirm members. 4. Club admins. Upload the club-and-admin export. A ready row becomes a club admin linked to the member from the previous step. Click Confirm club admins. Nothing is emailed. Copy link copies one person's link. Download all links (CSV) downloads them all. Each link works once, for 7 days. Send each person only their own link. This file contains live login links. Anyone who has it can take over these accounts until the links are used or expire (7 days). Don't email it as a whole, send each person only their own link, and delete the file afterwards. 5. Click Finish setup. Setup is locked. Your superuser account is now an LTF admin. These numbers are what was saved. Send each club admin only their own link. They open Your first password. Parked people are reviewed later under Parked members. They stay out of club lists, licenses, cards, teams and counts until then.

en.heading: I can't sign in.
en.text: Check the username (it is not always your email) and the password. If the page says your email isn't verified, see Verifying your email. If you forgot your password, see Forgotten password.

en.heading: Can members or parents sign in?
en.text: Parents cannot. A member aged 16 or over can sign in after a club admin or the LTF creates the sign-in. Nothing is emailed until you send the link. Younger members have no sign-in. The club keeps the data up to date. See Roles.

en.heading: A menu item described here is missing.
en.text: Your role or your club's modules do not include it. See Roles and Modules.

en.heading: I see the wrong club.
en.text: Open Selected club at the top of the page. It is a small panel. Choose the club, or search with Search clubs when the list is long. Every page then shows that club. See The screen at a glance.

en.heading: “Only the president, vice president, treasurer…” appears when I record a payment.
en.text: You do not hold a current committee office. Ask the president to update the Committee.

en.heading: A household is “Blocked” in billing.
en.text: Read the reason in the row. Usually a child needs a bill recipient (see Families) or no membership fee is set (see Membership fees).

en.heading: I can't choose a license type when ordering.
en.text: The reason is written next to the type: the ordering window is closed, there is no price, or the members already have that license. Windows and prices are set by LTF Finance.

en.heading: The printed card is shifted.
en.text: Print at 100 %, with no scaling, and ask the LTF for a printer profile if the card sits off the page (see Printing license cards).

en.heading: Dates look like mm/dd/yyyy.
en.text: Date fields follow your browser's language settings. Set your browser to English (United Kingdom), Luxembourgish, German or French to see day/month/year.

en.heading: The roll shows nobody.
en.text: On a new class, add students under trainingAddStudents and save. Next time, set them as trainingRegulars in the trainingTimetable.

en.heading: The calendar menu shows a number.
en.text: It is the number of upcoming events you can see. The word new appears when some of them are new to you.

en.heading: Where are my data protection rights?
en.text: If you can sign in, use the page in Privacy and your data. Members and parents ask their club or the LTF, who can export or correct the data.

en.heading: Can we pay online?
en.text: Yes. On an LTF invoice that the club still has to pay, Pay now opens the card company's page. It shows the invoice number and the amount still open. You enter the card and confirm. The app then says the payment succeeded and the licenses are activated. If you go back without paying, nothing is charged. Afterwards the button names the role you left, for example Back to club dashboard, Back to LTF dashboard, Back to finance dashboard, Back to your account or Back to ops. A club invoice sent to a member is not paid here. You can still pay by bank transfer. See Paying the LTF.

fr.heading: Bienvenue
fr.text: LTF Dojang Hub, c'est là que votre club et la Fédération luxembourgeoise de taekwondo tiennent le quotidien : liste des membres, licences, appel, cotisations, boutique, et un seul calendrier partagé. La fédération contrôle les licences, imprime les cartes et tient ses propres comptes. Vous vous en servez si vous travaillez pour un club ou pour la fédération. Un administrateur de club peut donner un identifiant à un membre à partir de 16 ans. Les parents ne se connectent pas. Voir Rôles. La page publique est noire et rouge. Elle affiche One federation. Every club. Every athlete.. Sign in ouvre la page de connexion. Si vous êtes déjà connecté, cet endroit affiche Open dashboard. Une fois dedans, Welcome back, suit l'affichage clair ou sombre que vous avez choisi.

fr.heading: À qui s'adresse ce manuel ?
fr.text: Le manuel est organisé selon ce que vous faites, pas selon les écrans. Lisez les deux premiers chapitres, puis passez au chapitre de votre rôle. Vous êtes… À lire ------ entraîneur Premiers pas, puis Entraîneurs, Équipes et compétition et Calendrier administrateur de club (président, secrétaire, trésorier, bénévole) chapitres 2 à 11 – commencez par L'année du club en un coup d'œil au secrétariat de la LTF LTF Admin ou LTF Finance administrateur technique Modules (administrateur technique) Les parents n'utilisent pas ce manuel. Qui peut se connecter est expliqué sous Rôles.

fr.heading: Comment lire ce manuel
fr.text: - Une case bleue, comme Sign out, reprend le texte anglais exact de l'écran. - Club management › navFinance › navBilling veut dire : ce groupe, puis cette page, puis cet onglet. - Suivez les étapes numérotées dans l'ordre. Une ligne avec une coche dit ce qui doit être vrai ensuite. - Les numéros rouges sur une image sont expliqués dans la liste dessous. Les astuces vous font gagner du temps. Les encadrés « Attention » vous évitent des erreurs difficiles à corriger. Les encadrés « Bon à savoir » expliquent pourquoi l'application se comporte ainsi.

fr.heading: Se connecter
fr.text: Ouvrez l'adresse que la LTF vous a communiquée. La page de connexion s'affiche. Pour vous connecter : 1. Saisissez votre nom d'utilisateur dans Username. Il figure dans l'e-mail de bienvenue, par exemple anne.reding. 2. Saisissez votre mot de passe dans Password. 3. Cliquez sur Submit. Vous arrivez sur la page d'accueil de votre rôle, par exemple l'aperçu du club ou l'aperçu de la fédération. La page de connexion reprend le noir et le rouge de la page publique. Forgot password? se trouve avec le formulaire. Voir Mot de passe oublié. Il n'y a pas d'inscription sur cette page. Un administrateur de club ou la LTF crée votre identifiant. Voir Administrateurs de club et Entraîneurs. Les parents n'en reçoivent pas.

fr.heading: Votre premier mot de passe
fr.text: Une nouvelle invitation ouvre Set up your account. La page nomme votre rôle et votre organisation, par exemple You're being set up as Club Admin for TKD Club Uelzecht (Demo).. 1. Vérifiez Username et Name. Ils sont déjà remplis. 2. Saisissez l'adresse e-mail que vous utiliserez dans Email. 3. Saisissez un mot de passe dans Password et à nouveau dans Confirm password. 4. Cliquez sur Save and continue. La page affiche Your account is ready!. Cliquez sur Sign in now. Un lien pour une personne qui a déjà un mot de passe ouvre Set your password à la place. Username est rempli. 1. Saisissez un nouveau mot de passe dans New password puis à nouveau dans Confirm password. 2. Cliquez sur Set password, puis sur Continue to login. Laissez votre navigateur ou votre gestionnaire de mots de passe enregistrer le nom d'utilisateur avec le nouveau mot de passe. C'est justement pour cela que la page le pré-remplit. Lors de la première installation, ces liens ne sont pas envoyés par e-mail. L'administrateur technique copie le lien de chaque personne. Ensuite, un administrateur de club ou la LTF peut le renvoyer. Voir Administrateurs de club.

fr.heading: Confirmer votre adresse e-mail
fr.text: Si la page de connexion indique que votre e-mail n'est pas encore confirmé, ouvrez l'e-mail de confirmation et cliquez sur son lien. Pas d'e-mail ? Cliquez sur Verify your email sous le bouton de connexion, saisissez votre adresse e-mail et cliquez sur Resend verification email.

fr.heading: Mot de passe oublié
fr.text: Sur la page de connexion, cliquez sur Forgot password?. Reset your password demande l'adresse e-mail du compte. Cliquez sur Send reset link. Si l'adresse est connue, un lien de réinitialisation est envoyé. La réponse est la même dans les deux cas, afin que la page ne révèle pas si un compte existe. Pas d'e-mail ? Demandez à votre administrateur de club ou à la LTF. Dans la liste des administrateurs de club, le menu de la ligne propose accessSendInvite si la personne n'a pas encore choisi de mot de passe, ou accessSendReset si elle en a déjà un. Si le message ne part pas, le lien s'affiche à l'écran comme adminResetLink. L'administrateur technique peut aussi utiliser Send password reset dans la console ops.

fr.heading: Confidentialité et vos données
fr.text: L'application a une page où vous gérez vous-même votre consentement et vos droits sur vos données. Elle ne figure pas dans le menu : vous l'ouvrez par son adresse. 1. Connectez-vous. 2. Dans la barre d'adresse du navigateur, remplacez tout ce qui suit l'adresse de l'application par /en/settings/privacy, /fr/settings/privacy, /de/settings/privacy ou /lb/settings/privacy, puis appuyez sur Entrée. La page Privacy & GDPR propose trois commandes : - I consent to data processing. (je consens au traitement des données) – cochez ou décochez la case. Le changement est enregistré aussitôt. - Export my data – affiche vos données sur la page, sous Export preview : les détails de votre identifiant et, s'il est lié à un membre, le nom, le grade et le club, les licences, l'historique des licences et des grades, et les détails de la photo. La page affiche les données. Elle n'enregistre pas de fichier. - Delete my data – supprime votre identifiant. Delete my data ne vous demande pas de confirmer. Votre identifiant est supprimé tout de suite, et vous êtes déconnecté. S'il est lié à un membre, la photo de profil disparaît, les notes de l'historique des grades sont effacées, et les adresses privées de ce membre sont retirées. Un administrateur qui supprime le même identifiant retire les mêmes adresses privées. Une adresse qui appartient à quelqu'un d'autre, par exemple un parent enregistré comme contact, reste. Une facture déjà envoyée garde l'adresse qui y était imprimée. La fiche du membre et les licences restent au club. Cette page est en cours de révision. Pour l'instant, son texte n'existe qu'en anglais, même si vous utilisez l'application en français, en allemand ou en luxembourgeois.

fr.heading: L'écran en un coup d'œil
fr.text: Chaque page a le même cadre : le menu à gauche, une barre en haut et la zone de travail au centre. Modifier une fiche ouvre un panneau sur le côté. La liste reste derrière. Dans une liste, les actions de ligne sont dans Row actions. Cliquez sur un en-tête de colonne pour trier. L'en-tête propose aussi Theme : Light, Dark ou System. Les pages publiques restent noires et rouges. Dans l'application, ce choix règle le thème clair ou sombre, y compris la ligne d'accueil. Sur un téléphone, ouvrez le menu en haut à gauche.

fr.heading: Les rôles : qui peut faire quoi ?
fr.text: Votre rôle décide du menu que vous voyez. Un identifiant peut regrouper plusieurs rôles, par exemple administrateur de votre club et admin LTF. Dans ce cas, l'en-tête affiche Desks. Ouvrez la liste et choisissez le rôle dans lequel vous travaillez. Un rôle marqué View only peut ouvrir ses listes. Enregistrer, supprimer et importer restent fermés, et la commande indique View only on this desk. Avec un seul rôle, l'en-tête affiche simplement ce rôle. Ops console dans l'en-tête ouvre la console technique et sélectionne ce rôle. Desks le présente comme la ligne Superuser, à côté de vos autres rôles. Choisir un rôle de club, LTF ou finances ouvre ce rôle. Open federation dashboard ne reste que lorsque cette liste ne peut pas déjà ouvrir l'aperçu de la fédération. L'admin LTF, les finances LTF, l'admin de club et la console technique demandent une application d'authentification. Pendant les 14 premiers jours, un avis vous le rappelle. Ensuite le rôle reste fermé tant que ce n'est pas fait. Le menu de langue propose English, Français, Deutsch et Lëtzebuergesch. L'anglais reste le défaut. Rôle à l'écran Personne type Travail principal --------- Coach entraîneur voit la semaine d'entraînement, fait l'appel, voit le calendrier Club Admin président, secrétaire, trésorier, bénévole gère le club : membres, licences, finances, entraînements, boutique LTF Admin secrétariat fédéral clubs, licences, cartes, transferts, équipe nationale, calendrier fédéral LTF Finance trésorier fédéral commandes, factures, paiements et comptes de la fédération Superuser administrateur technique quelles parties de l'application chaque club peut utiliser, et les identifiants Les parents ne se connectent pas. Un membre à partir de 16 ans peut se connecter une fois qu'un administrateur de club ou la LTF a créé l'identifiant. L'e-mail part seulement quand vous envoyez le lien vous-même. Le club garde les données et répond aux questions. Ce que chaque rôle voit dans le menu du club : Page Entraîneur Admin de club --------- navTraining oui ¹ oui navTeams si le module compétition est activé si le module compétition est activé Calendar oui oui navOverview, navMembers, navLicenses, navPrintJobs, navTransfers, navPromotion – ² oui navFinance, navFamilies, navShop – oui navClubAdmins, navSettings – oui ¹ Les entraîneurs voient la semaine, font l'appel et indiquent qui a donné le cours. L'horaire, les vacances, les tarifs et les règles de promotion sont modifiés par les administrateurs de club. ² Ces pages apparaissent dans le menu d'un entraîneur, mais ne sont pas encore prévues pour les entraîneurs. Un entraîneur qui est aussi administrateur de club les utilise en tant qu'administrateur. L'enregistrement des paiements est encore plus strict : il faut un mandat actuel au comité. Voir Qui peut enregistrer des paiements ?.

fr.heading: Les modules : pourquoi certains menus manquent
fr.text: Des parties de l'application sont activées par club par la LTF sous forme de modules : - Gestion du club (Club management) ajoute navFinance, navFamilies, navTraining, navPromotion et navShop sous Club management. - Calendrier des événements (Event calendar) ajoute Calendar sous Event calendar. - Compétition (moduleCompetition) ajoute navTeams sous Competition. Voir Équipes et compétition. Même sans module, vous disposez des pages Club : membres, licences, impression et transferts. Demandez à la LTF s'il vous manque un module. La LTF fixe un prix annuel pour la gestion du club et le calendrier. Une facture impayée ne désactive pas un module. Les administrateurs de club peuvent lire l'estimation sur le profil du club. Voir Frais des clubs et Profil. Un lot réunit au moins deux de ces modules à un prix forfaitaire. Sous moduleOrderOnTitle, un lot n'apparaît que lorsque ce lot lui-même a été acheté. Un lot qui ne contient qu'un module que vous avez déjà reste dans la liste sous moduleOrderChoose, et il dit moduleOrderModuleOn. Il ne montre pas la date de fin de ce module, et il ne peut pas être commandé à nouveau.

fr.heading: Entraîneurs
fr.text: Entraîneur Un administrateur de club vous nomme entraîneur dans navSettings › clubSettingsTrainersTab. Vous recevez alors un identifiant qui affiche Coach. Le rôle d'entraîneur est encore en construction. Ce chapitre décrit ce qui fonctionne aujourd'hui pour les entraîneurs : la semaine d'entraînement, l'appel et le calendrier. Quand le module compétition est activé, les entraîneurs ouvrent aussi navTeams (voir Équipes et compétition). D'autres fonctions pour les entraîneurs sont prévues.

fr.heading: Votre semaine
fr.text: Ouvrez navTraining. L'onglet trainingThisWeek liste tous les cours de la semaine avec leur statut et leurs entraîneurs.

fr.heading: Faire l'appel
fr.text: Faites-le pendant ou juste après le cours. Cela prend moins d'une minute. 1. Dans navTraining › trainingThisWeek, cliquez sur trainingOpenRoll à côté du cours. 2. Les élèves habituels sont déjà sur la liste. Cliquez sur un nom pour le retirer si l'élève était absent. 3. Sous trainingAddStudents, cochez les autres personnes présentes. La recherche aide si la liste est longue. 4. Vérifiez trainingSessionCoaches. 5. Cliquez sur trainingSaveRoll. Le cours apparaît désormais comme trainingStatusheld et ses heures comptent pour la prochaine ceinture de chaque élève (voir Promotion) et pour la rémunération des entraîneurs. Faites l'appel sur votre téléphone au bord du tapis. La page est conçue pour les petits écrans.

fr.heading: Le calendrier des entraîneurs
fr.text: Les entraîneurs voient les événements publics du club et aussi les événements calendarVisibilityinternal. Le club peut ainsi partager les réunions d'entraîneurs avec ses seuls entraîneurs et administrateurs. Voir Calendrier.

fr.heading: Administrateur de club : membres et licences
fr.text: Admin de club

fr.heading: Aperçu du club
fr.text: navOverview est votre page d'accueil. Elle s'ouvre avec Welcome back, et votre prénom. Needs your attention indique ce qui vous attend, ou Nothing needs your attention right now. quand il n'y a rien. La page compte aussi les membres, les licences et les factures ouvertes. actionQueueTitle liste ce qui attend, et chaque ligne ouvre la bonne page.

fr.heading: La liste des membres
fr.text: navMembers liste toutes les personnes de votre club. La colonne sexLabel est un petit ♂ ou ♀. Cliquez sur un en-tête de colonne pour trier. membersMenuLabel et le menu de ligne s'ouvrent en petits panneaux. La recherche reste sur la page. Les autres filtres s'ouvrent depuis Status, User et Person. User est accountFilterNone, accountFilterPending, accountFilterActive ou accountFilterDisabled. Sur la liste LTF, Person est All, Club members ou LTF staff. Sur la liste du club, Person est le filtre d'équipe quand la compétition est activée, y compris teamsFilterNone. Reset filters les ramène au départ habituel. Une coche reste quand vous cherchez, filtrez ou changez de page, jusqu'à clearSelection ou la fin de l'action. selectedMembersCountLabel compte aussi les lignes qui ne sont pas sur cette page. Les mêmes coches restent sur les listes de membres du club et de la LTF, les listes de licences du club et de la LTF, la liste des clubs LTF, les utilisateurs ops, les personnes mises de côté et la facturation du club. Le nombre de lignes peut être 50, 150, 300 ou toutes. Les tableaux de licences ont une colonne expiresLabel. Une date dans les 30 jours est un avertissement. Une date déjà passée est atténuée. Cliquez sur un nom pour ouvrir le membre. Le menu Actions agit sur tous les membres cochés à la fois : Préférez rendre un membre inactif plutôt que de le supprimer. La suppression efface aussi ses licences ; un membre inactif garde son historique.

fr.heading: Ajouter un membre
fr.text: 1. Dans navMembers, ouvrez membersMenuLabel et cliquez sur createMember. Le formulaire s'ouvre à côté de la liste. La liste reste en place. 2. Remplissez firstNameLabel, lastNameLabel, sexLabel et dobLabel. 3. Choisissez le ltfLicensePrefixLabel. Le numéro de licence LTF lui-même est attribué automatiquement à l'enregistrement. Ne remplissez WT license ID que si le sportif possède déjà une licence World Taekwondo. 4. Le grade de ceinture s'ajoute après l'enregistrement, dans l'onglet memberGradesTab. 5. Cliquez sur createMember.

fr.heading: Importer des membres depuis un tableur
fr.text: À utiliser une fois, quand votre club démarre avec l'application, ou pour ajouter tout un groupe. 1. Enregistrez votre liste au format CSV (une ligne par personne, une colonne par champ). 2. Dans navMembers, ouvrez membersMenuLabel et cliquez sur Import members. 3. Source and options : sous Existing members, laissez Create new only (skip existing) ou choisissez Create new and update existing quand le fichier doit actualiser des personnes déjà au club. Existing members are matched by LTF license ID, then WT license ID, then last name, first name, and date of birth in this club. Empty cells never clear stored values. Choisissez le Date format de votre fichier et cliquez sur Choose CSV file. Cliquez sur Continue to mapping. 4. Field mapping : pour chaque champ de l'application, choisissez la colonne correspondante de votre fichier. Auto-map matching fields fait l'essentiel du travail. Tous les champs marqués Required doivent être associés. 5. Preview and resolve : cliquez sur Preview. Chaque ligne est Ready, Duplicate, Invalid ou Skipped. Le même choix Existing members figure aussi à cette étape. Corrigez votre fichier ou changez l'action d'une ligne. 6. Confirm import : cliquez sur Run import. 7. Import result montre ce qui a été créé, mis à jour et ignoré. La ligne de succès dit Import succeeded. Created 12, updated 3, skipped 1.. Si votre fichier contient une colonne de fin d'affiliation, utilisez Use membership end dates by year pour importer les membres actuels comme actifs et ignorer ceux qui sont partis depuis des années. Il s'agit de l'import propre au club, pour un club qui utilise déjà l'application. Le premier import de tous les clubs par la fédération est une autre page, la première installation, visible seulement par l'administrateur technique. Une cellule vide n'efface jamais une valeur déjà enregistrée.

fr.heading: La fiche du membre
fr.text: La page d'un membre comporte six onglets. Si le sportif est en équipe nationale, l'aperçu montre nationalTeamBadge avec la sélection et la saison. Vous ne pouvez pas le modifier ici. Le club n'ouvre pas le dossier du staff de la fédération, et les noms des entraîneurs ne figurent pas sur cette page. La sélection elle-même est tenue par la LTF. Voir Équipe nationale. Quand le module compétition est activé, l'aperçu montre aussi teamsCardTitle et gearTitle. La taille et le poids sont notés sur la feuille d'équipe, pas dans un onglet ici. Voir Taille et poids et Tailles d'équipement.

fr.heading: Le dossier du club
fr.text: memberClubRecordTab contient les informations dont le club a besoin au quotidien. Tout est facultatif : remplissez ce que vous utilisez. On y trouve aussi Social security number, Joined this club, deux nationalités, Medical conditions / special needs, Email addresses, Phone numbers, Addresses, Publication consent et les dates des Médico sportif. Cliquez sur Save club record pour terminer. Pour une adresse au Luxembourg, saisissez une rue ou un code postal et choisissez une suggestion. La liste est le registre officiel des adresses luxembourgeoises. Le choix remplit Street, House number, Postal code et City / locality dans des champs séparés. Le champ rue ne garde que le nom de la rue. Un numéro peut comprendre une lettre, par exemple 12A. Cochez Send invoices here sur l'adresse qui doit recevoir les factures. Only one address receives invoices. Choosing this one clears the others. Pour un enfant, ajoutez le parent sous Contact persons et cochez Also use this parent for the other children in the family : le même parent sert alors aussi pour les frères et sœurs.

fr.heading: La photo d'un membre
fr.text: La photo est imprimée sur la carte de licence : une bonne photo évite une réimpression. 1. Ouvrez le membre et cliquez sur photoChangeButton. 2. Déposez une image dans le cadre, cliquez sur photoSelectFileButton, ou cliquez sur photoCameraButton puis sur photoCameraCaptureButton. 3. Réglez photoZoomLabel et faites glisser l'image pour que le visage remplisse le cadre 8:10. L'encadré photoPreviewTitle montre le résultat. 4.
